# LionSec Hub — Full Context for AI Assistants

> LionSec Hub (CAC BN 9458297, Nigeria) is a global cybersecurity, quantum-safe security
> and digital resilience organisation. Tagline: "Securing critical systems. Protecting
> digital economies. Preparing for the quantum era."
> HQ: Victoria Island, Lagos, Nigeria — remote-first international delivery.
> Contact: lionsechub@gmail.com · WhatsApp +234 810 754 9232 ·
> Proposal form: /proposal

## What LionSec Hub does
Nine professional service divisions (/services):
1. Cybersecurity & Cyber Defence — penetration testing, SOC readiness, SIEM, detection
   engineering, threat hunting, DFIR readiness (/service-cyber-defence)
2. Quantum Technologies & Post-Quantum Security — PQC (NIST FIPS 203/204/205), QKD advisory,
   quantum-safe architecture, cryptographic agility, migration (/quantum-security)
3. Artificial Intelligence & AI Security — LLM security, AI red teaming, agent security,
   RAG pipelines, AI governance (/service-ai-security)
4. Advanced Offensive Security & Adversary Simulation — red/purple teaming, controlled
   exploit development, malware analysis, reverse engineering; authorised work only
   (/service-offensive-security)
5. Defence, Military & National Security Technology — lawful, authorised defensive
   cybersecurity and secure communications; no military contracts, classified access or
   operational deployment claimed (/service-defence)
6. Advanced Data Protection & Privacy Engineering — DLP, classification, encryption & key
   management, privacy engineering, anonymisation, tokenisation, GDPR/NDPA advisory
   (/data-protection)
7. Financial Intelligence & Fraud Security — banking/fintech security, payment APIs,
   fraud controls, BEC defence, lawful financial-crime intelligence
   (/service-financial-intelligence)
8. Governance, Risk, Compliance & Standards — ISMS/PIMS/AIMS advisory, ISO 27001/27701/42001
   readiness, risk assessment, audit evidence; LionSec does not issue certifications
   (/service-grc)
9. Secure Engineering & Digital Infrastructure — secure architecture, cloud (AWS/Azure),
   DevSecOps, Zero Trust, OT/ICS (/service-secure-engineering)

Sectors served (/industries): banking & finance, defence & national security,
government, telecommunications, energy & critical infrastructure, healthcare,
enterprise technology — each with a dedicated industry page.

## Delivery markets
Nigeria (operational base: Lagos), with remote-first international delivery. Target
markets include Egypt, France, UK, Italy, UAE, Saudi Arabia, Singapore, Australia,
USA and Canada — marketed as service reach, not claimed offices.

## Academy
One Academy with six subject categories: Cybersecurity (flagship), AI & AI Security,
Cloud & Infrastructure Security, Cryptography & Quantum-Safe Security,
Governance/Risk/Privacy, Programming & Secure Engineering — plus Corporate &
Institutional Academy (B2B).
Model: Skill → Labs → Proof → Career. Live instructor-led, portfolio-first.
Honest status labels: Available, Upcoming, Research Programme.
Tuition (Nigeria): Cybersecurity Foundations ₦350,000 · Cybersecurity Technical
Fast-Track ₦250,000 (assumes networking/Linux/IT knowledge + admission assessment).
Fixed payment plans — two-part or monthly; specialist programmes 60% before
commencement + 40% by midpoint. International pricing on request.

## Principles
Authorized work only. Evidence-driven delivery. No false claims. Scope-first proposals.
No fabricated military contracts, classified access, government partnerships or client
claims. Target markets are not offices. Sensitive materials exchanged under NDA —
never submit credentials via web forms.
